# Safi Jamil

> Brand strategist and Google Ads specialist in the PPC industry since 2018. Helps US-based e-commerce and service brands generate sales and leads through Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads, with full-funnel conversion tracking from click to closed customer. Currently managing $261,855+ in active ad spend across car rental, home services, paint, and retail businesses. Based in Lahore, Pakistan; works remotely with clients across the US and Pakistan.

Safi Jamil is a Google Ads and Meta Ads specialist, not an agency — clients work directly with the person managing their account, not an account manager relaying instructions to someone else. Core services: Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), conversion tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, CallRail call tracking), landing page CRO and A/B testing, and click-fraud protection (ClickCease). Clients keep full ownership of their ad accounts and data at all times.
